text:
jamie_oncall: Starting preflight for change window — rolling v1.12.3 -> v1.12.4. Deploy-bot, kick off the health probes and report quick signals. tagging @eng-platform for visibility.

deploy-bot: preflight summary (automated):
```
- kvcache-health: OK
- prefix-cache: OK
- embeddings-route (eu-west): 5xx spike detected (3m window)
- p95 latency global: +10ms (within threshold)
- queue-depth: nominal
```

clem_sre: :eyes: seeing a burst of 5xxs from embeddings-route in eu-west starting ~4745122960, request traces show backend 502s. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/embeds/eu-west-overview

mike_runtime: Is that canary-only? quick grep shows `nodex-12` reporting OOM-ish logs and `kv_realloc` churn during quant kernel init. snippet: `ERROR kernel_init: out-of-memory on alloc 0x7ff...`

sara_release: Let's not shift more traffic. Propose hold for eu-west and pin routes back to v1.12.3 until triage. Anyone object?

jamie_oncall: Agree. Running: `deploybot pause --scope=eu-west --reason="embeddings 5xx spike"`

deploy-bot: action taken — traffic shift paused for eu-west. Current live version for eu-west pinned to v1.12.3. Incident tag: #deploy-4745123000-hold

clem_sre: I'll roll the canary back to 1.12.3 on the affected pool and start a scoped trace. Creating ephemeral trace: `tracer start --pool=eu-west-embeds --duration=15m`

mike_runtime: FYI v1.12.4 includes the new quantization kernel `qk-v2` that touches memory allocation paths. Recommend trying `--feature-flag=disable-qk-v2` if we need quick workaround rather than full rollback.

sara_release: Good call. If clem can confirm reproducer with kernel off, we can decide whether to revert or flip flag. For now hold traffic. I'll add a note to release notes: "Hold: embeddings 5xx increase in eu-west when rolling v1.12.4; investigating quantization kernel interactions."

jamie_oncall: Action items: 1) hold traffic shift (done), 2) pin eu-west to v1.12.3 (done), 3) try `disable-qk-v2` on a test node, 4) if not resolved within 2h open postmortem. I'm updating the change-window doc and slack #incidents if it escalates.

sara_release: :thumbsup: I'll notify CS and update the release notes + customer-impact field for eu-west tenants.

mike_runtime: I'll stand by to roll a quick flag patch and push a test to eu-west-canary. Will post results here.

clem_sre: tracing + log collection kicked off. Early traces point to allocator spikes right at model init. attaching logs to the incident ticket.

jamie_oncall: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for the deploy hold. If you observe any other regions start to trend, ping here immediately.
